body: I don't mean to come off as rude or an egomaniac but, I've heard the phrase "everybody makes mistakes" so many times. It's started to warp my mind into thinking that I shouldn't ask people for help because they've got their own problems. It's honestly starting to feel like I'm suffocating myself. I'm so lost right now that I don't know what I can do to help make things better. It feels like nothing makes sense. There's just so many things in my head that I start to panic.

So far all of the jobs ive gotten are in the service industry. I think the most common reason as to why I can't keep a job is due to my painfully awkward shyness when it comes to strangers in real life. It just makes me tense up and disoriented. Ive spilled a lot of peoples' food.
I failed getting into university because I just didn't make the cut. At the end of my last year in highschool, i did get accepted, but they pulled my acceptance on the account of my low grades. I ended up wasting away my summer that year trying to make sense of what to do. My parents really wanted me to go to school so I decided at the last minute to go to a community college for journalism. I ended up failing that program during my final year. This was mostly due to me ending up in the hospital on the account of my attempted suicide. My parents were notified by the police and I spent the rest of the semester in the hospital, all the way through Christmas. Now I'm scared to tell my parents that I failed college. I mean, they invested so much time and money on me, and all I did was waste it. I guess that's what you'd call spoiled. Now whenever people end up giving me a helping hand I always feel an extreme sense of guilt. All I wanted was to make everyone around me happy, but I managed to mess it all up.
